info.description: Organization-scoped feedstock intake, production runs, biochar products, lab samples, orders and balances, and read-only customer and destination lookups, including formulations and output bin stock movement history. Business dates are facility-local YYYY-MM-DD; event times are sent as RFC 3339 with an explicit offset or as facility-local { date, time }, and returned as UTC instants. Additive changes remain in v1; breaking versions use v2 with Deprecation and Sunset headers. Unsupported methods on visible paths return Problem405 with Allow listing supported methods, including automatic HEAD and OPTIONS. Private refusals follow bearer authentication and path visibility checks; unknown or invisible paths return 404 without Allow. Public discovery paths need no credential. post.description: Record one delivery with a generated code. A delivery sends finished product from a product bin to a customer against an order and deducts from the bin. Feedstock intake uses POST /feedstocks. Masses are wet kg; moisture is percent of wet mass. On create, moisturePercent is the measured reading. moisturePercent is ignored when sources are sent; each source carries its own reading and the stored value is the server-derived overall (1 minus total solids divided by wet mass) times 100, including ingredient solids. Distances are one-way km and the server counts the round trip. distanceKmOverride must be above 0; omit it to use the customer location's distance. deliveredAt is resolved in the order facility's time zone and cannot be in the future; DST gaps and folds are refused. Without sources, a split bin draws in its drawOrder, shown in the bin stock read. The dry run shows which products would be drawn in allocations, also returned on committed creates. Pass the dry run's basisFingerprint on the real write; a stale fingerprint answers 409 stock_basis_changed with a fresh stock preview including allocations when available. Without it the write acts on current stock. Missing, foreign or archived orders and archived order facilities answer 404 not_found at /orderId. Missing, foreign or archived bins answer 404 not_found at /storageLocationId. Missing or foreign drivers and vehicles answer 404 not_found at /driverId and /vehicleId; missing or foreign source products at /sources/i/layerId. Invalid bin type, facility or formulation answers 422 validation_failed at /storageLocationId. Own-org source products in another bin or placed after the delivery answer 422 validation_failed at /sources/i/layerId. Sources on a mix bin answer 422 validation_failed at /sources; missing moisture at /moisturePercent. Future deliveredAt and local DST gaps or folds answer 422 validation_failed at /deliveredAt. Unknown fields answer 422 validation_failed at their field pointer with issue code unknown_field. An order balance overage answers 409 conflict at /deliveredWetMassKg with measure order_remaining_wet, availableWetKg, requestedWetKg and unit kg in issue metadata. Stock overdraw answers 409 insufficient_stock at /deliveredWetMassKg with the bin, measure, availableSolidsKg, requestedSolidsKg and unit kg. Certified order lineage answers 409 certification_locked at /orderId. A stale basisFingerprint answers 409 stock_basis_changed with a fresh preview when available. A non-blocking warning asks you to upload the bill of lading as a delivery document of type bill_of_lading. Idempotency-Key is required, including dry runs. Dry runs roll back and return stockEffects and basisFingerprint; committed creates return Location and ETag. Required scope: deliveries:write.

post.description: Record a loss or a count on a biochar or product bin, by bin UUID. A loss is wet mass that left the bin. A count is the whole bin weighed: it resets stock and moisture and never raises stock, and a count of 0 records the bin as empty. Corrections are not available. A feedstock bin answers 422 and a missing, archived or foreign bin 404, both on /storageLocationId. Dry runs return basisFingerprint with the stock effects. Send it back as basisFingerprint to refuse the write if stock moved since; the refusal is 409 stock_basis_changed with a fresh preview. Without it the write acts on current stock. Masses are kilograms and moisture is percent of wet mass. Send event times as RFC 3339 with an explicit offset or as facility-local { date, time }; a time in the future is refused. Movements are not versioned and have no read by id, so the 201 carries neither ETag nor Location. Required scope: biochar-products:write.
